summary.narrative: Foundations, Wayfinding, Tight Loops, Safe Passage, and Handoff are largely complete across 8 documentation files (README.md links + docs/), with all 6 PR CI checks (including CodeQL and OWASP ZAP), CodeRabbit review, 11 template-formatted GitHub spec/bug issues, and main branch protection active. Momentum has the most room for improvement (scheduled readiness re-runs, offline privacy vs. error tracking, and agent-commit attribution), alongside single-container hosting limits on staged rollouts and on-call paging. The single highest-leverage next step is deciding which offline/single-container items belong in .ai-readiness.jsonc skips and adding a scheduled readiness workflow in CI.
